notes.title: Introducing Our Publishers, Release Date Update, and Discord!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! The past few weeks have been pretty busy and intense (in a good way) for everyone at the studio, but we haven’t forgotten about you. In fact, we have some very exciting updates regarding Legrand Legacy’s release!  

[h1]Introducing… Our Publishers![/h1] 

We’re thrilled to announce that we are partnering with two esteemed publishers for the release of Legrand Legacy. [b]ANOTHER INDIE[/b] will be working with us for our worldwide launch, while [b]MAYFLOWER ENTERTAINMENT[/b] will be taking care of our South Korean players. You might have heard of [url=http://anotherindie.com/games/]Another Indie[/url] from other premium games, like Lost Castle and Sinner, so we're looking forward to working with them on Legrand Legacy.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/e1df5fdf832b3434e3259279fc6e334f566a4bfd.jpg[/img][i]Watch out world![/i]

[b]What does this mean for you?[/b]

Well, this means that Legrand Legacy will be coming to you in [b]English, Russian, Mandarin Chinese, Korean,[/b] and a few [b]more languages[/b] planned in the near future. This also means that you will be seeing more of us in [b]upcoming events[/b], like GDC or PAX East, so we can say hi to you face to face. Lastly, we hope you’re looking forward to a ton of [b]swags, giveaways, and freebies[/b] for Legrand Legacy’s launch because we’ll have LOTS of them!  

[h1]Release Date & Discord[/h1]  
Our current goal is to release Legrand Legacy for Windows [b]some time in January 2018[/b]. We’re still ironing out the details so we don’t have an exact date yet. 

In the meantime, we've set up an [b]official Discord[/b] (discord.gg/ai) and we cordially invite you to hang out with Henry, AJ, and me, along with fellow Legrand Legacy players for some pre-launch fun. If you have any questions and suggestions about Legrand Legacy or life as a gamedev in general, please don't hesitate to drop by!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/dcaf623f9468594dbaea765c5cd1d27dc745162f.jpg[/img][i]Come hang out with us :)[/i]
 
[h1]Thanks for Reading[/h1]

These partnerships are a HUGE deal for us because it means that Legrand Legacy will be able to reach MORE players worldwide, so we hope that you’re as excited to read today’s update as we are. We do have a few more surprises in store, so stay tuned for the next update! 

-Revinia & the SEMISOFT team-

notes.title: Console Update
notes.notes:
Hello backers! As promised, we have some very exciting news to share with you.

[h1]WE ARE OFFICIALLY A LICENSED DEV FOR PS4, XBOX ONE, AND SWITCH![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/846dd29b2042cc671213c274d4f87d073a7bb2bc.jpg[/img]
[i]Which one is your favorite, PS4, Switch, or Xbox One?[/i]

This means that Legrand Legacy is CONFIRMED for [b]Sony Playstation 4, XBox One, and Nintendo Switch[/b]. However, our current focus now remains on completing the Windows version first, which also means that the console games will only be out AT LEAST a year AFTER the PC version is out (some time in Q1 2019 or later).

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/2779edaafd251777e50843967c742a7310d73b91.jpg[/img]
[i]Our platform lineup is finally complete![/i]

Hope this update made your day just as much as it made ours :) Have a good weekend everyone!

- Revinia & the SEMISOFT Team -

notes.title: A Note on Release Date
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!  

As September comes to a close, you may have realized that Legrand Legacy's release date will be postponed. As far as game progress, we are actually in the QA stages of development, so we still need more time for bug testing, localization, and generally making sure that Legrand Legacy is as POLISHED and SHINY as it can be. This means that [b]the game will be fully completed some time in Q4 2017[/b].   

[i]HOWEVER...[/i]  

End of the year is typically a less than ideal time for indie games because of the holidays, festivities, and the torrent of AAA releases, which will overshadow games from smaller studios like us. In addition, during Gamescom, PAX, and TGS, we met with a lot of potential publishers or partners, and we are currently in discussion with some of them for possible exciting collaborations (which we'll definitely share with you in the future!). As such, [b]we might have to push our release date to some time in Q1 2018[/b]. This also means that we will only be shipping physical rewards to our backers after Legrand Legacy has been released.   

[i]IN THE MEAN TIME... [/i] 

Rest assured that we are still working on the game and the physical rewards. Here's a sneak preview to the limited edition Finn figurine, hand-painted and all!  

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/9c82e0d63df52ee454b1b7a7fe07f1cc10a3fd8f.jpg[/img][i]You like? You like?[/i]

Finally, we are very grateful for your understanding. Your input, kind words, and emotional support fuel us and push us to continuously improve on our craft. Once we have a confirmed release date, [b]be it in Q4 2017 or Q1 2018[/b], you will be the first to know!

-Revinia & the SEMISOFT Team-

notes.title: Beta Beta Beta: New Screenshots & Patch
notes.notes:
[h1]Beta Eye Candies[/h1]  
Hello all! We hope you’re having a grand time exploring Legrand Legacy's new Beta. If you can’t play it, fret not, we have A TON of new screenshots to share with you today. Also, since a picture is worth a thousand words, we'll keep words to a minimum here. 

Enjoy!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/017/473/922/f8aba267f1a81f7d8b39b55a0fdfe114_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1499848062&auto=format&q=92&s=32a1c9b3544e42fd8877a10149a5526c[/img] 
[i]You finally get to say hello to Scatia, the cold-hearted "century old witch", and everyone's favorite, Azzam. Your team is now complete![/i]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/017/473/927/18e3dcbb175825a95a4d41cb94c33ea7_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1499848129&auto=format&q=92&s=8cc707090b9205cc6b603c245b934cf1[/img]
[i]Arkwora is just one of the many epic bosses you'll have to battle during your adventure in Legrand.[/i]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/017/473/961/361917c45cc6ecdbc7f1da17878913b9_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1499848326&auto=format&q=92&s=f9587b0e2fd00f551048037d2e0c4420[/img]
[i]Recruit craftsmen, Scout Legendary Blacksmith, and restore Dumville back to it's former glory[/i]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/017/473/976/dae51f32b4d5e115bfc2481d346c870f_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1499848387&auto=format&q=92&s=2971e79d767efdbe8c3e959397edfc25[/img]
[i]Take your entourage around this (seemingly) idyllic fishermen's village, but knowing Finn & friends, troubles are bound to find them wherever they go...[/i]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/017/474/024/02c4538af6c482f777b2805a160590c6_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1499848734&auto=format&q=92&s=dabac27d90e4ead26996526266e01267[/img]
[i]Or maybe you prefer to trek through the lush yet forbidden Gwenelle Forest? Who knows what magical creatures you may find here...[/i]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/017/473/990/f37ba98e4bb9c03f24a01b45ebb11a9d_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1499848495&auto=format&q=92&s=e1dd93e0b3d3e06e54788fa3dbf0bab9[/img]
[i]New side quests are now available so don't be shy, talk to those townsfolk![/i]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/017/474/014/9c23f4a6a21260e60b1b71fac1611e70_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1499848641&auto=format&q=92&s=796a649fe8c1edd861360337debbeb99[/img]
[i]Let's see if you can put your war general hat on and come up with the best war strategies...[/i]

[h1]Your Beta Got Patched![/h1] 

While you weren’t looking, we’ve also released a new patch to balance the battles and fix some of the bugs and other issues that you have reported in our official Steam thread.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/017/474/330/d5c7c93f1e95adec044ed6e93d4c1e9b_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1499850887&auto=format&lossless=true&s=9f7f55d4960bd0489b3acaba50a1325a[/img]
[i]Noticed anything new in your game?[/i]

[list]
    The full list of items that were updated is as follows:

[*]+ Add particle war  

[*]+ Balancing war Ostia, Dumville  

[*]+ Balancing normal battle chapter 1-5

notes.title: Version A vs. Version B
notes.notes:
By now you’ve probably played the new version B of our Pre-Alpha. You may be wondering, what’s the difference behind this new version and the previous one (version A)?

[b]VERSION A[/b] is the original Pre-Alpha that we launched with our first Kickstarter. If you watch YouTube Let’s Play videos dated before January 18th, 2017, they are most likely playing this build. Version A is available only on GameJolt.

[b]VERSION B[/b] is the revised Pre-Alpha that we launched with this new Kickstarter. We took your feedback from last time and have implemented some changes into this new build. Version B is available on Steam as well as on GameJolt.

Now let’s talk about some of the things that have changed in Version B.

[h1]Battle UI[/h1]

A big change for version B is that we now have an additional user interface which gives you detailed information about the enemy. This includes, for example, monster type, element type, weakness, and HP bar. Our goal is to make it easier for you to plan your attack and defense actions.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/279/452/e0d1683ca42bb8b67a45750f21a43e2d_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1485320742&auto=format&lossless=true&s=b093b9ac355290c4118c0a98e6a66813[/img]

[h1]Action Circle Tempo (ACT)[/h1]

You will notice that ACT now only appears at the beginning of combat. Also, based on popular request, you can now choose your own flavor for ACT depending on the desired playing experience:  

•	You can choose either to press a fixed button (easier) or to get randomized buttons (harder)

•	You can choose either to have a fixed (easier) or randomized (harder) Perfect/Good area

•	The arrows in version A have been replaced with ABXY, which we hope will make it more intuitive

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/279/488/70cd8b2dcd7181868e94c2e465e31ad0_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1485321045&auto=format&lossless=true&s=be869230df6d346155b93e41d50cf23e[/img]

[h1]Character’s Skill Attribute[/h1]

At the end of the battle, you can now immediately add Attribute Points (ATP) to level up your character.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/279/504/6632f447b9292b94310c54369a691978_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1485321178&auto=format&lossless=true&s=97892e3bc67cd65b345e8a675106485b[/img]

[h1]Other Cosmetic Changes[/h1]

You may also notice several cosmetic changes which we hope will make your experience more enjoyable. These include enhanced visual effects, improved textures for some monsters, map pointers, and more!

[h1]Why do we have two versions of the Pre-Alpha?[/h1]

We want Legrand Legacy to be a game that YOU enjoy, so we will be conducting a poll after the Kickstarter is over to gather your feedback about both versions so that we can know into which direction to take the Legrand Legacy gameplay.

[url=https://ksr-video.imgix.net/assets/015/279/540/bdc6c2ed73396eba15ed61b7a4aabad3_h264_high.mp4]check the video here![/url]

But for now, we do want to hear from you! Do you prefer the ACT dial to appear right before each attack and defense action (as is the case for version A) or all at once at the beginning of combat (as it happens now in version B)? Please let us know in the comments below!
